about: Reader-facing UI catalog. Keys are identical in en, es-419 and zh-Hans. strings.*: chrome text with {name} placeholders. plurals.*: CLDR categories by plural_rule (one_other: count == 1 -> one, else other; other: always other). labels.<group>.<code>: human label for every enum code shown to readers; never print the raw code (fallback: labels.gap_kind.other for unknown gap kinds, otherwise omit). date: explicit month and weekday tables and patterns; do not use platform locale data (ICU gives 'Sept'). Timestamps with precision minute or hour are converted to America/Mexico_City before formatting; values with precision day or month are calendar dates and are formatted from their UTC date without a time-zone shift. Reference formatter: tools/mark_pending_localizations.py format_date().
